builds.hypothesis: Wall R3 is1.5*(400+1 AP+0.5 bonusAD) physical. AP is efficient but armor penetration, not MR penetration, improves this packet. Deathcap/Banshee/Zhonya maximize AP for physical AP ratio; Riftmaker adds AP/conditional ramp; Serylda penetrates armor; Shojin tests12% ability amplification. No MR penetration on physical packet.

kitEvidence.formula:
Mini Gnar Passive: Increase Hyper's Move Speed.

Mega Gnar: Gnar tosses nearby enemies, dealing [200 / 300 / 400 + (1) × AP + (0.5) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage, Knocking Back, and Slowing them by [45]% for [1.25 / 1.5 / 1.75] seconds. Enemies that hit a wall instead take [(200 / 300 / 400 + (1) × AP + (0.5) × AD[statFormula=2]) × ((150) × (0.01))] physical damage and are Stunned.

builds.name: Hyper: Mini Gnar AP third hit
builds.summary: Investigate high one Mini Gnar Hyper detonation output under a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high one Mini Gnar Hyper detonation output under a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: The Mini W helper adds 0/10/20/30/40 + 1.0 AP magic, and the raw rank-indexed percentage data adds enemy maximum-health damage (14% at rank 5). AP has a full coefficient on a repeatable third-hit packet. The Mega W helper instead uses 45/75/105/135/165 + 1.0 total AD physical damage and must not be substituted.
